scientific_integrity: The canonical stationary measure and its strong-recovery thermodynamic mean are credited to existing work; the finite-size double scaling and intensity intermittency are assessed. A finite verifier does not certify asymptotic limits. Priority and correctness have not undergone independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the instantaneous configuration-dependent stationary transition intensity; no theorem on temporal, time-integrated current fluctuations, mixing or hydrodynamic limits. Requires particle density strictly between zero and one and beta/alpha of order N^2.
title: Critical finite-ring intermittency in the tandem exclusion process
